8.35. iLock_Geography.predicate_manager¶

The module defines a container datatype PredicateManager, used to store instantiated predicates.

The instance of any predicate class (subclass of GeoPredicate) needs to be registered in a predicate manager with an unique name, in order to be used to populate the corresponding PiSPEC paramter(s).

By default, all instantiated predicates from iLock_Geography.builtins are registered upon the instantiation of PredicateManager.

Classes

PredicateManager(railyard[, useBuiltins]) A predicate manager is used to maintain a collection of registered names and the associated predicate instances.
